name: Selfishness
overview: Scripture reveals selfishness as a destructive attitude that disregards the needs of others and opposes God's commands. Cain's refusal to care for his brother exemplifies the heart of selfishness, while Nabal's unwillingness to share provisions highlights its practical harm. Haman's prideful expectation of honor above all demonstrates the spiritual danger of self-centeredness. God's law calls His people to love their neighbors as themselves, rejecting selfishness in favor of sacrificial love and communal responsibility.
